prompt: Teddy trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Dino Book Trade
irony: Teddy trades lunch away to read about hungry dinosaurs, then a shared pancake proves what you give away comes back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunlit diner smells like pancakes while Teddy gazes at Benny's big dinosaur book.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy wants the book and recites tooth facts, correcting Lou about meat-eaters at the counter.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Benny offers a trade: the dinosaur book for Teddy's warm lunch plate.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Teddy hugs the book tight, tummy rumbling, while friends chant the lunch trade.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy munches cold crumbs from a pocket and misreads hungry roars as real.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Sterling trumpets a fancy feast from the truck, and Benny believes each tall tale.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Teddy clutches the empty plate, still chanting, while the dinosaur roars grow louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou counts coins behind the counter and feels the sting of an empty childhood lunch.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou slides warm pancakes to Teddy and keeps the dinosaur book close for shared reading.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Lou sings the turned line as Teddy shares pancakes with Benny under string lights.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Friends chant softly as sunlight fills the diner and the shared book opens wide.
